mike-dev: Quick ask — need temporary access to decrypt a batch of prod logs. Customer reported possible PII (emails) in yesterday's logs. Need to inspect raw lines and produce a redacted subset for support. Ticket: INC-4127. Requesting 30m decrypt + ability to upload redacted file to secure bucket. Who can approve?

lexi-sec: Can you add exact justification, the commands you'll run, and a precise window? Security prefers 15m windows but can do 30m with manager approval. Also: do not export raw unredacted data off network.

mike-dev: Justification: customer reported leaked email addresses after deploy, support needs examples to confirm and roll back. Repro steps narrow. Proposed window: 15:10–15:40 UTC (30m). Commands will be gcloud kms decrypt on `logs.bundle.enc`, grep for email regex, redact, then upload redacted. Manager is @sara-manager.

sara-manager: I approve a 30m window for mike-dev to access logs for INC-4127. Follow the security SOP (session recording, attach ticket). :white_check_mark: 

lexi-sec: Approved conditionally from security. We'll grant ephemeral role `role/logs-just-in-time` for 30m. No raw exports permitted. Start a recorded session with `/session-bot start` and paste exact commands here before you run them. Security will attach the audit ID to the ticket.

mike-dev: Commands I'll run (posted for audit):

```
# from bastion
ssh bastion
sudo -u logs-reader bash
# decrypt
gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=prod-keys --key=ingest-key --ciphertext-file=logs.bundle.enc --plaintext-file=logs.bundle
# search for emails
grep -E "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}" logs.bundle > findings.txt
# redact emails in-place
sed -E 's/([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g' findings.txt > findings_redacted.txt
# upload redacted sample to secure bucket
gsutil cp findings_redacted.txt gs://redwood-secure/inc-4127/
```

jamie-infra: Quick infra notes — KMS decrypt calls are audited (kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt). Use the ephemeral credentials we provision (no long-lived keys). Prefer `gsutil cp` to secure bucket (locked ACL) instead of scp. I'll provision the role and watch the session.

session-bot: Session token created for mike-dev, expires in 1800s. Session link: https://sessions.redwood.internal/s/XYZ (masked). Audit ID: AUD-9876

lexi-sec: Thanks — I'll attach AUD-9876 to INC-4127. Reminder: redact any token-like strings, IPs not needed, and do not include full log bundles in the ticket. If you find >50 email hits stop immediately and @lexi-sec and @sara-manager. :warning: 

mike-dev: Understood. Starting at 15:12 UTC (slightly earlier to finalize). I'll paste the redacted sample here when done and close the window.

jamie-infra: Role bound and session enabled. Monitoring the session. Ping for +15m if you really need it.

sara-manager: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Keep customer updated and close the incident once validated.
